records.paths: Local project, asset, model, archive, cache, temp, and backup path categories are represented by the local storage contract.
records.permissions: Permission observations are a local contract field; live permission probing is not claimed.
records.free_space: Free-space observations are represented separately from used totals; no live device value is claimed.
records.scan_freshness: Scan freshness is an explicit field and must be measured by a caller; no stale reading is promoted to live.
records.removable_media: Removable-media handling is represented as a local-only certification field; no hardware probe is claimed.
records.failure_recovery: Failure recovery is fail-closed through invalid-field reporting; no physical fault or power-loss proof is claimed.
records.limitations: Synthetic local evidence only; provider connectivity, credentials, telemetry, hardware, hosted CI, signing, billing, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
